payload.title: M11 Wave 6: Course 2 typed assembly, c2/01-05, with G8, G9 and D12
payload.description: Part of M11 (SIE-e8c918). c2/01 cards-have-short-names (asm chip on card faces). c2/02 type-one-line (editor slot). c2/03 write-f (label, ret; editor region). c2/04 two-inputs. c2/05 a-function-calls-a-function (save ra; D12 stack view, part of G6 but needed here). Engine: G8, G9.
